Hi Samira / MedWise Security — thanks for the questions. Quick technical + contract summary from engineering/privacy: 

1) BAA coverage by deployment mode:
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools under customer tenancy): Yes — Redwood signs BAAs for Dedicated deployments. These provide isolation, dedicated hardware pools, and dedicated namespaces for models/keys.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Yes — full support for BAAs; commonly used for regulated workflows and air-gapped requirements.
- Hosted (shared multi-tenant): Generally not the recommended path for PHI. We evaluate Hosted on a case-by-case basis; in rare circumstances we can offer BAA coverage if strict contractual controls and additional isolation layers are put in place (e.g., customer-dedicated tenancy, customer-managed keys, and explicit routing policies). For MedWise, given the volume and PHI types you described, we typically recommend Dedicated or Private.

2) Technical controls we can document for the questionnaire:
- Encryption: TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest.
- Customer-managed keys: Available for Dedicated and Private (KMS/HSM integrations). Hosted supports provider-managed keys by default; CMKs can be discussed for high-compliance customers.
- Audit logs: Per-request tracing, token-level logging, and exportable audit logs for a configurable retention window.
- Data retention & deletion: Configurable retention policies per deployment; ability to purge cached prefixes/KV for specific datasets.
- Model routing/ACLs: Route policies can restrict which models an application can call and can enforce fallback/deny rules. We can set per-customer model allowlists and blocklisted integrations.

3) Practical next steps:
- If MedWise sends the questionnaire we will pre-fill answers and return within 3 business days for the initial pass.
- We can provide a SOC 2 summary and the BAA draft (attached by Marissa). For legal redlines, our legal team prefers to review and iterate via DocuSign or tracked PDF comments.
- If you prefer, schedule a short technical session (30-45m) between your security team and our solutions + infra folks to walk controls and any environment-specific questions.

I can also produce a short one-page controls mapping that aligns our features to typical questionnaire sections (security, confidentiality, access controls, monitoring).

Let me know which option you prefer and I'll coordinate.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
